fields.description: Issue includes local nightlife and society gossip columns ("They Tell Me" and "I'd Like to Know"), extensive coverage and commentary on racing (including horse racing figures and Florida racing politics, and a dog-racing column), advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach bars, clubs, restaurants, and services, and listings of radio programs. Also includes a feature on the National Wine & Liquor Exposition and other local events and promotions.
